# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [AI memory crunch pushes MacBook Air into shortage](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ai-memory-crunch-hits-macbook-air.html): Apple's highest-volume laptop is now short of supply as DRAM makers divert wafers to AI data centres, with custom orders slipping into September.
- [Alibaba opens QwenWork enterprise agent to public beta](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/alibaba-qwenwork-public-beta.html): Alibaba merged three internal agent products into QwenWork, a suite pairing desktop, cloud and team agents on top of the new Qwen3.8 model.
- [Cogent AI gates VR-1, a cyber attack-path model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cogent-ai-vr-1-cyber-model.html): Cogent AI released VR-1, a security-specialised model that composes and verifies multi-stage enterprise attack paths, with weights withheld from the public.
- [Genspark open-sources GenOffice suite for PC and Mac](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/genspark-open-sources-genoffice.html): Genspark released GenOffice, which it calls the first full-featured open-source AI office suite, free and ad-free on Windows and macOS.
- [MiniMax releases open weights for its H3 video model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/minimax-h3-open-weights-release.html): MiniMax published downloadable weights for H3, its omni-modal 2K video model, making a top-ranked video generator locally runnable for the first time.
- [Alibaba launches 2.4T-parameter Qwen3.8-Max via API](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/qwen3-8-max-launch.html): Alibaba's new flagship is a 2.4-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model aimed at long-horizon agent work, with open weights promised next week.
- [Sakana AI launches Namazu, a Japanese-tuned LLM API](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/sakana-namazu-japanese-llm-api.html): Tokyo lab Sakana AI opened commercial access to Namazu, a Japanese-specialised model built by fine-tuning Moonshot's open-weight Kimi K2.6.
- [Apple caps bug reports as AI-written filings flood in](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/apple-caps-ai-bug-reports.html): Apple has imposed a submission ceiling and a 30-day cool-off on Feedback Assistant bug reports, blaming a deluge of AI-assisted findings.
- [California's AI provenance law binds 1M-user providers](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/california-ai-transparency-act-live.html): SB 942 became operative on 2 August, forcing large generative-AI providers to embed provenance data and publish a free detection tool.
- [EU AI Act's content-labelling rules take effect today](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/eu-ai-act-article-50-live.html): From 2 August the AI Act's Article 50 transparency duties bite across the EU: machine-readable marking, chatbot disclosure and deepfake labels.
- [Bolt ships an autonomous security agent to every project](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/bolt-security-agent-every-project.html): Bolt added an agent that scans, patches and hardens apps built on its platform in one click, with audits and remediation excluded from billing.
- [Epoch grows open-math benchmark as AI solves two more](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/epoch-open-problems-two-more-solved.html): Epoch AI expanded its FrontierMath Open Problems set to 50 research questions and logged two fresh AI solutions, both in the middle "Moderately Interesting" tier. Three problems were pruned in the same update.
- [Gemini Spark agent reaches AI Pro in 160+ countries](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-spark-international-ai-pro.html): Google opened its background-running personal agent to AI Pro subscribers in more than 160 additional markets, a week after the tier launched in the US.
- [Google pulls Earth AI image tool one day after launch](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-earth-ai-image-tool-pulled.html): Google rolled back a Nano Banana 2-powered generator that let users paint fabricated imagery onto satellite maps, citing policy-violating outputs being shared online.
- [Munich court finds Suno liable for training and outputs](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/munich-court-suno-copyright-ruling.html): Munich Regional Court I ruled that Suno infringed copyrights in both training and generated music, rejecting the company's US-style fair use defence. Suno says it disagrees and is weighing an appeal.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [AI 抢内存，MacBook Air 陷入缺货](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ai-memory-crunch-hits-macbook-air.html): 内存厂商把产能让给 AI 数据中心，苹果销量最大的笔记本开始缺货，定制机型发货排到了 9 月。
- [阿里「千问办公」开启公测，企业级 Agent 三端合一](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/alibaba-qwenwork-public-beta.html): 阿里将 QoderWork、MuleRun、悟空三款产品整合为千问办公，桌面端、云端与协同 Agent 打包，底座换成新发布的 Qwen3.8。
- [Cogent AI 发布 VR-1：受控开放的攻击链推理模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cogent-ai-vr-1-cyber-model.html): Cogent AI 推出安全专用模型 VR-1，可组合并验证企业级多阶段攻击路径，权重不公开，仅向审核通过的机构开放。
- [Genspark 开源 GenOffice：面向 PC 与 Mac 的 AI 办公套件](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/genspark-open-sources-genoffice.html): Genspark 发布 GenOffice，自称首个功能完整的开源 AI 办公套件，Windows 与 macOS 均可免费使用且无广告。
- [MiniMax 放出 H3 视频模型开源权重](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/minimax-h3-open-weights-release.html): MiniMax 正式开放全模态视频模型 H3 的权重下载，让一款榜单前列的视频生成模型首次可以在本地部署运行。
- [阿里发布 2.4 万亿参数 Qwen3.8-Max，API 先行](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/qwen3-8-max-launch.html): 阿里新旗舰 Qwen3.8-Max 为 2.4 万亿参数 MoE 模型，主打长周期智能体任务，官方称下周开放权重。
- [Sakana AI 上线日语专用大模型 API「Namazu」](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/sakana-namazu-japanese-llm-api.html): 东京实验室 Sakana AI 基于月之暗面开源的 Kimi K2.6 微调出日语特化模型 Namazu，正式开放商用 API。
- [AI写的漏洞报告太多，苹果开始给提交量设限](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/apple-caps-ai-bug-reports.html): 苹果对Feedback Assistant的漏洞提交设置数量上限并附加30天冷静期，理由是AI辅助生成的报告泛滥。
- [加州AI透明度法生效：百万用户级模型须标来源](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/california-ai-transparency-act-live.html): SB 942于8月2日正式施行，要求大型生成式AI提供方在内容中嵌入来源信息，并免费提供公开的检测工具。
- [欧盟《AI法案》透明度义务今日正式生效](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/eu-ai-act-article-50-live.html): 8月2日起，《AI法案》第50条透明度义务在欧盟全域直接适用：机器可读标记、聊天机器人身份披露与深度伪造标注同步落地。
- [Bolt 给每个项目内置自动化安全智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/bolt-security-agent-every-project.html): Bolt 上线安全智能体，可一键扫描、修补并加固平台上生成的应用，审计与修复均不计费。
- [Epoch 未解数学题库扩至 50 题，AI 再攻克两道](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/epoch-open-problems-two-more-solved.html): Epoch AI 将 FrontierMath 开放问题集扩充到 50 道真实未解研究题，并新记录两项由 AI 取得的解答，均属中间的「中等有趣」档位；同一次更新中另有三道题被移除。
- [Gemini Spark 下沉 AI Pro，覆盖 160 多个国家](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-spark-international-ai-pro.html): 谷歌把常驻后台的个人智能体 Spark 开放给 160 多个新市场的 AI Pro 订阅用户，距其在美国下沉该档位仅一周。
- [上线一天即下线：谷歌撤回地球生图功能](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-earth-ai-image-tool-pulled.html): 谷歌撤回由 Nano Banana 2 驱动的生图功能，此前用户可直接在卫星地图上生成并叠加虚构影像。
- [慕尼黑法院判 Suno 训练与输出双重侵权](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/munich-court-suno-copyright-ruling.html): 德国慕尼黑第一地方法院认定 AI 音乐生成工具 Suno 在训练与生成两端均构成侵权，并驳回其美式「合理使用」抗辩；Suno 称不认同判决，正评估包括上诉在内的选项。

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs

- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-08-03.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
